items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I'm going to get Raymond Galapio's picture. His wife told me she'd give it to me.

ctx.x: Yeah, Willie Parker was in there.

He'd play a bass drum. You never would get that picture of Willie Parker? I'm going to go over there and I'm trying to get my picture from Willie Parker. He's got my picture over there. When I was a young man, that's what I wanted to give it to you, when I was screwing Cotton, Cotton Screwman. And I'm trying to get that picture. I'm going to ask him for his picture. I'm more sure he'd give it. I'm going to get Raymond Galapio's picture. His wife told me she'd give it to me. And Willie Phillip's son said he'd give…
He goes to him to him. He goes to him to him.
